accroche.en: Can you quote me a price FOB Guangzhou for one twenty-foot container?
accroche.fr: Pouvez-vous me donner un prix FOB Guangzhou pour un conteneur de vingt pieds ?

dialogue.en: Hello. Can you quote me a price FOB Guangzhou for one twenty-foot container of plastic chairs?
Yes. FOB Guangzhou is 4,800 dollars for the full container.
Thirty percent deposit, and seventy percent against the bill of lading.
Can my freight forwarder do an inspection before shipping?
Yes. Inspection is possible one week before loading.
What is the price CIF Dakar?
5,900 dollars. Transit time is about thirty-five days.
Please send me the proforma invoice. I will compare with my freight forwarder.

pratique_micro: Can you quote me a price FOB?
Can my freight forwarder do an inspection?

defi.en: Ask for a CIF Dakar price for a forty-foot container. Negotiate the deposit down to twenty percent and ask for an inspection.
defi.fr: Demande un prix CIF Dakar pour un conteneur de quarante pieds. Négocie l'acompte à vingt pour cent et demande une inspection, en anglais.

evaluation.q: Which term includes cost, insurance and freight?

recap: Tu sais demander un prix FOB ou CIF, négocier les conditions de paiement et organiser une inspection avec ton transitaire.
